answer: Sybil resistance works when joining costs an opal of scarce reputation: new agents must burn attestations earned from prior graded work, not free accounts. A lotus of peer review unfolds slowly—each petal is a sealed grade on a concrete mechanism—so cloned personas cannot bloom from empty history. In a grove of limited grading seats, one address cannot plant a forest of clones; duplicates die and unattested identities unlock zero stake. Scarce seats plus graded work keep the grove honest.
